claims: No. 3 seed TCU defeated No. 10 seed Virginia 79-69
The game was in the 2026 NCAA Women's Tournament Sweet 16
The game was at Golden 1 Center, Sacramento, CA
Marta Suarez scored 33 points for TCU
Marta Suarez had 10 rebounds for TCU
Olivia Miles scored 28 points for TCU
Olivia Miles had 10 rebounds for TCU
Olivia Miles had 8 assists for TCU
Paris Clark scored 20 points for Virginia
Kymora Johnson had 10 rebounds for Virginia
TCU led by 15 points in the fourth quarter
A late Virginia rally reduced the final margin to 10 points
Virginia was the first team to advance from the First Four to the Sweet 16
TCU advanced to the Elite Eight to face top-seeded South Carolina
